title: Diana Pasulka's turn while writing her book

tellings.quote: Uh, and then all of a sudden the second half of that book is like she goes down the rabbit hole herself and it's like, "Oh my god, I think there's something extremely real."

plain: According to Michels, the scholar Diana Pasulka of UNC Wilmington changed her own view partway through writing a book about the subject. In the second half, he says, she 'goes down the rabbit hole herself' and comes to think: 'Oh my god, I think there's something extremely real.' Michels tells this from his own reading of the book, which the show lists as Heaven Can Wait, and he offers it as a case of a careful academic who came to take the phenomenon itself seriously.
